news.title: DoorDash Retains Lowest-Cost Delivery Position Despite Fee Increases, Wells Fargo Finds
news.summary: DoorDash (NYSE:DASH) remained the lowest-cost third-party delivery provider in the third quarter, according to a Wells Fargo pricing survey released on Tuesday, despite recording the largest quarterly fee increase among the platforms compared. The survey found that DoorDash’s total basket costs were approximately 2% below those of Uber (NYSE:UBER) and Instacart, even as its fees increased 3.

news.title: Costco Ramps Up Same-Day Delivery, Expanding Uber, DoorDash Partnerships

On Thursday DoorDash said it would also start delivering Costco products in the U.S. from all U.S. locations.
